description: List recent deploys for a project. Returns deploy history with id, status, trigger, timestamps, commit info, service info, duration, and URL. Use to understand what changed: "what deployed since it broke?", "which deploy was the last working one?", or to find a deploy_id for rollback_deploy or get_deploy_logs. Paginated — returns up to limit (default 10, max 100) most recent deploys. For multi-service projects, use service_id to filter deploys for a specific service.

service_id.description: Optional service ID to filter deploys for a specific service.

name: list_deploys
